excerpt: ByteAsk opens a full-screen TUI, reads your codebase, edits files, compiles, runs tests, and presents a diff for your review before making permanent changes
ByteAsk joins through a bridge you start in your gdb, reads the live state, and asks before it changes anything.
It hands back the raw report with the frames, files and line numbers intact, so you can check the agent's reasoning against the same evidence.
For scripting and CI pipelines, use the `exec` subcommand
Streams the session as JSON Lines on stdout - one event per line. Use it when a pipeline needs to consume the run rather than a human reading it.
Point at a JSON Schema file and the model's final response conforms to it, so you can parse the resu
ByteAsk asks for your approval before taking actions. The policy is set via `--ask-for-approval`
Bring **any OpenAI-compatible model** into the ByteAsk TUI and drive it exactly like a built-in cloud model.
byteask models add <alias> --provider openrouter --key sk-...` connects OpenRouter, Groq, Together, DeepSeek, Mistral, xAI, Cerebras, or Fireworks with just your own key
ByteAsk uses **magic-link email sign-in** - no API key required by default.
you and the person who referred you each get $10 of usage credit
Page-cited answers from embedded & firmware reference docs — for coding agents that can't afford to guess a register value.
Shows your current plan and how much of each usage window you've spent.
Redeem a voucher code for a one-time credit top-up. Credit covers usage past your plan limits.
Your plan is upgraded automatically once payment completes - no need to sign in again.
A screen-reader mode renders panes as linear, announce-once text and substitutes a plain symbol set on non-UTF-8 terminals.
`/keymap` can genuinely rebind keys including two-key chords
A read-only run can still build your program under AddressSanitizer and run it.
It edits your repository from the terminal, then drives the real toolchain - sanitizers, your test suite, and any gdb session you already have open - and hands you a diff that survived the debugger.
`byteask exec` - it runs one task to completion and exits.
If you want the agent to build, test, or write files, pass `--sandbox workspace-write`.
When someone installs ByteAsk with your code and signs up, **you both get $10 of credit**.
`byteask queue` sends a message into a running session from another terminal
`/recap` summarizes on demand
`/cd` and `/pwd` change and show the working directory mid-conversation
`/agents` opens a session command center
Your session now renews itself quietly at launch, and anyone already expired is healed on their next launch with no email round-trip.
vim mode gained undo, redo, dot-repeat and search motions
VS Code, Cursor, and JetBrains (CLion, IDEA, PyCharm) connectors are live.
`auto` is a chain across three models and two providers rather than one fixed choice, so if one is having a bad day your turn quietly lands on the next
